acceptanceCriteria: Every merge-queue run retains exactly one forward row artifact whose name carries its class; missing selection artifacts produce INCOMPLETE.
Focused tests cover CLEAN, FLAKY, MISS and INCOMPLETE classification, including rerun of missed failing packages.
PR runs stay FULL; no required check changes meaning; actionlint, ci-least-privilege-check and independent review are retained.
A count of complete shadow rows and failing rows against the 20/5 bar is readable from retained artifacts.
body: Decision 0431 (docs/decisions/0431-merge-queue-backstops-pr-test-selection-2026-10-05.md, PR beamfall/corvint#611) was accepted by the owner on 2026-10-05 with all four open questions answered as recommended: closed allowlist for scope UNKNOWN, shadow bar of 20 complete rows with at least 5 failing, kill switch at 2 MISS or 3 INCOMPLETE rows in the latest 20 plus CORVINT_PR_NARROWING=off for a reviewer-confirmed CHANGE_CAUSED miss, V1-0760 before narrowing and queue group size 1. Queue enablement and merge_group support are CORE-GITHUB-MERGE-QUEUE-COMPATIBILITY-1; main-push reuse of the queue run is V1-0760; the umbrella is V1-0616. Items 6 and 7: with PR runs still FULL, compute and retain the Corvint selection S for each PR before the full shard runs, and on each merge-queue run compare the failing package set F against S. A row is named ci-forward-<CLEAN|FLAKY|MISS|INCOMPLETE>-pr<N>-<queue sha> with the worst class in the row; each failing missed package is rerun once; missing or unreadable inputs make the row INCOMPLETE, never clean. In shadow a PR run also produces its own row.
title: ci: record forward qualification rows from merge-queue runs in shadow (decision 0431 items 6-7)
